heading: Monday, February 17, 2025
topLine: 2 model releases: Mistral AI Mistral Saba and xAI Grok 3.

items.headline: Mistral releases Saba, a regional model for Arabic and South Asian languages
items.summary: Mistral Saba is a 24B-parameter model trained on curated data from the Middle East and South Asia, supporting Arabic and many Indian-origin languages. It is Mistral's first specialized regional model and is available via API and for local deployment.

items.headline: xAI releases Grok 3 and Grok 3 mini
items.summary: xAI launched Grok 3 and the smaller Grok 3 mini, trained on its Colossus cluster, with reasoning (Think) modes and a DeepSearch tool, initially for X Premium+ subscribers and a new SuperGrok tier. xAI reports 93.3% on AIME 2025 and a 1402 Chatbot Arena Elo; API access followed in April.
